title: Exterior 2D Div-Curl Problem for Non-Solenoidal Flows with Infinite Energy and No-Slip Boundary Condition
content: In the paper we study 2D div-curl problem in exterior domain for the flow with given vorticity, divergency, boundary condition at infinity and no-slip condition on the solid surface. We will derive moment relations on vorticity and divergence for uniqueness solvability of the problem. Numerical results which confirm presented research are given.
